interfaces.canvas: SpatialCanvas adds optional playing:boolean; actual quality/audio/motion are derived presentation state; referenceSurfaceFrame(anchor,upright=false) preserves legacy plane frames and typed Y-up roots
interfaces.library: SpatialAssetBrowser({busy,onAdd:(name:string)=>void,onNew}); onAdd accepts a catalog ID or an existing classic preset name, routes through normal Scene edit/history; saved compositions reuse My Spatial Library SAVE/CAS.
interfaces.entity: src/parallax/element-contracts.ts: spatialElementSchema and SpatialElement on optional canonical entity.element; original entity.kind enums stay unchanged
interfaces.package: src/parallax/asset-catalog.ts: assetPackage/version1.0.0, physicalAssets, ModelId and lightweight model descriptors; public/parallax/sc02/manifest.json pins GLB hashes and provenance
interfaces.inspector: SpatialElementInspector({entity:SpatialEntity,onChange:(element:SpatialElement)=>void}); host dispatches existing CONTENT patch, preserving parent/history/selection
interfaces.insertion: src/parallax/element-authoring.ts: insertSpatialElement(input,catalogId,id), extractComposition(input,rootId,definitionId), insertSavedComposition(input,composition,prefix), createAssetShowcase(id,family) return ordinary SpatialDraft content
interfaces.environmentBoundary: SC-01 immutable Environment pin and optional Scene scenePresentation lighting remain separate from per-entity LIGHT; no second Environment/Scene store or navigation was added
